questions.text:
1    
30 people took a literacy test and a numeracy test.

2    
120 people were asked if they prefer tea or coffee.

3    
500 people were surveyed. 
All of the people were either left handed or right handed.

4    
Caleb makes a cola drink. 
He is doing a taste test. 
He asks 80 people if they prefer cola A or cola B.

5    
80 people were asked if they like football.

6    
60 students study a language at a school. 
        
Each student either studies French or German.

7    
75 students either go to a football club or a rugby club at the weekend.  
        
Each student either goes to the club on Saturday or Sunday.
